title: The City’s shared illustrations

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Make shared illustration reusable because one visual vocabulary can support different messages without requiring new artwork every time.
strategic_value: Reusable pieces can help Helsinki connect resident information, presentations and marketing.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section lists uses for shared illustrations, links the library and encourages combining pieces or using individual elements.
practical_value: Choose whether a whole composition or a single shared element best supports the communication.
